name: SSHI_FBR_Zener
rationale: Integrating a Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) circuit to invert the voltage across the piezo capacitance Cp at each peak. This effectively increases the voltage seen by the rectifier, overcoming the diode drops that caused failures in S2 and S4 in the reference design. A full-bridge rectifier (FBR) is used for energy extraction, a Zener diode (DZ33) clamps the output to 3.3V to prevent exceeding vmax (fixing S3), and a storage capacitor filters ripple.
